_readme: Machine setup. Change these once, then forget them. policy.json is the file you actually play with.

mxc._note: binDir is the folder that contains <arch>\wxc-exec.exe. The shipped value is the copy of the MXC executables that travels with CastleKeep, in bin\ - see bin\README.md. Point it elsewhere, or set exePath, if you want a different build. MXC_BIN_DIR also works.

lemonade._note: Lemonade Server runs on the HOST and is never sandboxed. The agent loop talks to it directly. baseUrl is probed for both /api/v1 and /v1 style routes.
lemonade._model_note: Must match a model Lemonade has INSTALLED, exactly. /api/v1/models is the installed list; ?show_all=true is the catalogue, and a name can be in the catalogue and still 404 because nobody pulled it. Use workshop\models.py rather than typing a name from memory.
